description: Whether a listing can be delivered to a destination, what delivery adds on top of its buyer_price_usd (0 means it is included), the distance, and the total the buyer pays. When no quote is possible, `unresolved` says which end could not be placed: "origin" means the listing's own location is unknown, so no address the buyer gives will help. `reason` is the platform's own wording, and "calculated manually" in it means no quote yet: whenever there is no automatic quote, whichever end is at fault, the team prices that delivery by hand, and needs_manual_quote is true (ask Commonplace support for one: support_create_ticket where this connection has it, otherwise the support line, (516) 357-5989). A quote gives included_miles (free) and per_mile_usd, the category's rate for miles 101 to 200 and beyond 200. Delivery within 100 miles of the item is already included in its price; beyond that a per-mile fee applies, and most items cannot travel beyond 1,500 miles.

listing_id.description: The listing's numeric id, from a search result.
